Narrow artificial intelligence vs. artificial general intelligence 
About 90% of the models of AI are narrow intelligence.
On the current state of the art, we have two set of models for artificial intelligence: narrow artificial intelligence and artificial general intelligence. Even if you apply transfer learning to a narrow artificial intelligence, it is still narrow in the sense it cannot be applied outside their classical designed application
